verdict.rationale: Tailscale documents automating a tailnet through infrastructure-as-code providers, webhooks and integrations, plus event-notification webhooks and ephemeral authenticated connections for GitHub-hosted runners. This is integration plumbing that external systems drive, not product-native background automations that run on their own. One community report also says API keys expire after 60 days and need manual re-login, which undercuts fully unattended operation. Missing for 10: native scheduled or autonomous automation features, documentation of long-running unattended workflows, and independent hands-on corroboration of background automation.
